h.select_rule: Discard any hypothesis whose condition is the edited field's own current value, or whose condition merely disables or disconnects the edited component. From the rest, keep 10 with distinct mechanisms and field pairs, favouring those where an informed expert could plausibly bet on either direction.
h.strategy: Two patterns are banned because experts find them obvious: (1) conditioning on the current value of the same field being edited, which just restates that upgrading a weak setting helps more than upgrading a strong one; (2) conditions that make the edited component unused, unreachable or inert. Instead, each hypothesis must link two DIFFERENT fields that interact through a non-trivial mechanism, such as substitution between parallel routes, a capacity already supplied elsewhere, one part acting as a bottleneck for another, or interference that turns a usually helpful edit harmful. No condition setting may appear in more than two hypotheses. Use the gaps and negated assumptions as the source of each idea. In each 'why', name the mechanism and explain why the opposite direction is also a priori plausible.

hyps.why: An identity route straight into the output already eases optimization, so adding a 3x3 conv on edge 5 yields a smaller gain.
A skip into node 2 passes stable raw features, so the conv on edge 5 operates on a well-conditioned input and adds capacity without a deep conv stack.
Without the direct input-to-output edge, edge 4 is one of only two routes to the output, so upgrading its capacity matters more.
With a direct 3x3 conv into the output, a pooled route through node 2 contributes mostly blur and dilutes the sum.
With edge 5 removed, the direct edge is one of the few routes carrying input features to the output so giving it a 3x3 conv matters more.
With edge 5 removed, node 1 reaches the output only via edge 4, so its capacity directly determines how much of that branch is used.
With edge 2 removed, node 2 is fed only by edge 1, so its op fully determines node 2's representation.
With edge 1 removed, edge 2 is the only feeder of node 2, so upgrading it matters more than when a parallel route exists.
Without the direct edge, all input information passes through edge 0 or edge 1, so edge 0's quality is a bottleneck.
With edge 4 removed, node 1 information has one fewer route to the output, so a strong direct 3x3 from the input compensates more.
